news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS and revenues miss analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹9.16 (down from ₹21.31 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹38.3b (up 28% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹773.5m (down 52% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 2.0% (down from 5.4% in FY 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue missed analyst estimates by 3.5%. Earnings per share (EPS) also missed analyst estimates by 23%. Revenue is forecast to grow 29% p.a. on average during the next 2 years, compared to a 12% growth forecast for the Luxury industry in India.

news.title: Investor sentiment improves as stock rises 18%
news.body: After last week's 18% share price gain to ₹433, the stock trades at a forward P/E ratio of 15x. Average forward P/E is 22x in the Luxury industry in India. Total returns to shareholders of 14% over the past year.

news.title: Consensus EPS estimates fall by 49%
news.body: The consensus outlook for earnings per share (EPS) in fiscal year 2026 has deteriorated. 2026 revenue forecast decreased from ₹41.0b to ₹39.5b. EPS estimate also fell from ₹23.05 per share to ₹11.85 per share. Net income forecast to grow 139% next year vs 28% growth forecast for Luxury industry in India. Consensus price target down from ₹563 to ₹536. Share price fell 3.6% to ₹427 over the past week.

news.title: Price target decreased by 7.2% to ₹538
news.body: Down from ₹580, the current price target is an average from 2 analysts. New target price is 22% above last closing price of ₹443. Stock is up 30% over the past year. The company is forecast to post earnings per share of ₹14.00 for next year compared to ₹21.31 last year.

news.title: New minor risk - Profit margin trend
news.body: The company's profit margins are lower than last year and have reduced by more than 30%. Net profit margin: 2.9% Last year net profit margin: 5.6% This is considered a minor risk. A large drop in profit margin could indicate the company does not have strong competitive advantages or it is yet to establish itself and its core business. Even if it is a well established business, this may make it a much riskier investment than one that has a combination of proven competitive advantages and a stable or growing profit margin. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risk Debt is not well covered by operating cash flow (17% operating cash flow to total debt). Minor Risk Profit margins are more than 30% lower than last year (2.9% net profit margin).

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: ₹0.57 loss per share (vs ₹4.67 profit in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: ₹0.57 loss per share (down from ₹4.67 profit in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹10.8b (up 46% from 3Q 2025). Net loss: ₹47.7m (down 114% from profit in 3Q 2025). Revenue is forecast to grow 32% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 14% growth forecast for the Luxury industry in India.
